source.title: 2026 Aggregate Fantasy Draft Rankings - 12-team half-PPR, Season 21
source.scoring: 0.5 PPR, 4pt pass TD, 25 yds/passing pt, -2 INT, -2 fumble lost
source.player_pool: QB/RB/WR/TE only - this league has NO kicker and NO defense slots
source.method: Each source converted to a rank, blended on the weights above, then adjusted for (a) this league's roster structure and (b) news that postdates one or more sources. A soft penalty is applied at half weight when a source omits a player rather than dropping the signal.

source.draft_mechanics: Round 1 runs 1->12, round 2 runs 12->1, and round 3 ALSO runs 12->1 instead of flipping back. Normal snake resumes in round 4. The practical effect is that the reversal transfers value toward the back of round 1: slot 12 picks at 12, 13 and 25, while slot 1 picks at 1, 24 and 36.

plan.core_principle: Overall value declines smoothly here - there is no single cliff to game. The cliffs that ARE real are positional: after the top 2 TEs, after roughly RB22, and after roughly WR34. Draft against those, not against the overall list.
plan.rounds_1_3: Take the best available RB/WR. With only 2RB/2WR/1FLEX you need four to five genuinely startable RB/WR, and this is the only place to get them. Do not take a QB. Take a TE only if Bowers or McBride falls to you.
plan.rounds_4_7: Keep hammering RB/WR. This is where the FLEX spot and your first bench pieces get filled. If you missed the top 2 TEs, Loveland or Tyler Warren here is fine value; otherwise keep waiting.
plan.rounds_8_10: Take your one QB. QB8 through QB13 are separated by very little and any of them starts all season. If you have not taken a TE, take one now - the TE7-TE15 range is effectively interchangeable.
plan.rounds_11_13: Pure upside. No kickers, no defenses, so every one of these picks is a live RB/WR swing. Prioritise (a) the direct backup to your own starting RBs and (b) receivers with a path to volume if someone ahead of them misses time.

structural_notes: NO KICKERS AND NO DEFENSES. roster_positions contains zero K and zero DST slots and enforce_position_limits is on, so those picks are unavailable and would be wasted anyway. Every other team in a normal league burns 2 of 15 picks there; here nobody does. This ranking contains only QB/RB/WR/TE. Do not draft a kicker or a defense under any circumstances.
Only 156 total picks. Anything past roughly rank 160 here will not be drafted, so late-round targets should be genuine upside swings, not depth.

One QB, 12 teams, 4-point passing TDs. Twelve starting QBs for twelve teams means the 12th-best QB is free. Waiting on QB is materially correct in this format. Rushing quarterbacks gain extra value because rush yards score at 10 yards per point versus 25 for passing yards.

One TE, no TE premium. Same logic as QB: there is a real cliff after the top two, but TE7 through TE14 are close to interchangeable. Either pay for Bowers/McBride or wait a long time - the middle is the trap.
Six bench spots and no K/DST to stash means every bench slot is live RB/WR upside. Handcuffs to your own starting RBs and high-variance receivers are worth more here than in a 15-round league.
Half PPR (0.5) sits between formats: pass-catching backs and slot receivers gain over standard scoring but not as much as full PPR. Do not import full-PPR rankings wholesale.
Replacement level: with 2RB + 2WR + 1 FLEX across 12 teams, roughly RB30 and WR30 are the waiver baseline. Value a player against that line, not against RB1.
